roster.name: DDI Lifecycle (DDI 3.3)
roster.description: A comprehensive metadata model and XML schema for describing the full lifecycle of social, behavioral and economic data (study-level, questionnaire, data capture, data description, archival metadata). Includes a Technical Guide, model documentation, and XML schema for serializations and best-practice usage.

roster.name: DDI Data Documentation (DDI 3.3)
roster.description: The DDI 3.3 Data Documentation specification/module providing structures and item/field types for documenting datasets and their variables (study, data description, classifications, agent information). Appears as a distinct documentation set within the DDI 3.3 product suite.

roster.name: DDI-Codebook (DDI-C)
roster.description: The earlier/codebook-oriented DDI product for documenting data and codebooks (variable-level metadata). Cited in relationship discussions and listed as a separate DDI product; represents a more compact/codebook-focused metadata format distinct from the Lifecycle model.

roster.name: DDI Common Core (ISO/PAS 25955:2026)
roster.description: A common-core metadata specification from the DDI Alliance formally published as ISO/PAS 25955:2026. Provides a core set of metadata elements for interoperability across DDI products and other systems.

roster.name: DDI Cross-Domain Integration (DDI-CDI)
roster.description: A DDI product focused on cross-domain integration of metadata—designed to support exchange and harmonization of metadata across domains and datasets (listed as a separate DDI product on the site).

roster.name: XKOS and SDTL (Extended KOS; Structured Data Transformation Language)
roster.description: Two DDI-related products listed on the site: XKOS (an extension to SKOS for representing statistical classifications) and SDTL (a Structured Data Transformation Language for describing or recording data transformations). Both are presented as distinct DDI Alliance products supporting classification and transformation metadata, respectively.
